channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Pi, Aptos, Optimism and four more top 250 tokens hit record lows as bitcoin slid to $61,273
item.description: Seven tokens worth $2.57 billion together set all-time lows between Thursday evening and early Friday, CoinGecko data show. Six are down more than 97% from their peaks.

item.title: SEC says fake crypto platforms took $37 million from 1,500 Americans, with SEC filings as bait
item.description: The SEC sued eight Colorado-registered entities on Thursday. Its complaint says WhatsApp groups steered victims into fake trading apps, then demanded fees to withdraw, while the money moved on to Tron.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin at $61,768 is still above MARA's $39,674 energy cost per coin
item.description: As bitcoin slid under $62,000, posts claimed it now costs more to mine a coin than it sells for and that miners are dumping. We checked five claims against price data and a large U.S. listed miner's own filings.

item.title: Thursday's ETF outflow revised sevenfold: bitcoin funds lost $632 million, ether $129 million
item.description: The first readings showed $90.8 million leaving U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs and $5.2 million leaving ether funds on Thursday. Revised data now put it at $631.9 million and $129.4 million, the worst bitcoin fund day of November.

item.title: Binance's wallets hold 680,028 bitcoin, 1.7 times OKX, Bitfinex, Bybit and Bitget combined
item.description: CoinMarketCap's reserve tracker counts $124.65 billion in Binance's listed wallets, including $30.2 billion in USDT and USDC. DeepSea's flow data show $1.55 billion more left Binance than arrived over seven days.

item.title: Bitcoin fell 3%, yet its Hyperliquid bets held at $1.23 billion. HYPE's shrank $64 million
item.description: Open bets on Hyperliquid's 179 crypto markets slipped to $3.25 billion, CoinGecko data show. Bitcoin's market did not shrink in five days, while HYPE and ether bets fell and Hyperliquid dropped from third to sixth by open interest.

item.title: Sky's USDS shrank $1.67 billion in one hour Thursday, and staked sUSDS lost 46% in a day
item.description: USDS fell from $8.45 billion to $6.37 billion in about a day, most of it between 11 a.m. and noon ET Thursday. Its savings version, sUSDS, dropped by $1.37 billion in the same stretch, while the dollar peg held.

item.title: Anthropic tokens hit $116 on day one, then fell 22%. Hyperliquid ANT bets traded $1.71 billion
item.description: On-chain versions of Anthropic shares peaked near $116 on Thursday and traded near $90 by Friday morning. Fewer than $4 million of the tokens exist, while bets on Hyperliquid's ANT market traded $1.71 billion in a day.

item.title: Zcash fell 14% and 30 top traders are 95% short. Influencer mk4 is short again
item.description: DeepSea counts $76.82 million of Zcash shorts on Hyperliquid against one $4.11 million long. Influencer mk4, whose $13.4 million Zcash short was gone on November 16, now holds a $4.60 million short.

item.title: NEAR fell 13% and top traders are 67% short, but the biggest bet is a $6.5 million long
item.description: Fifteen tracked Hyperliquid wallets hold $18.61 million of NEAR shorts and $9.32 million of longs. One trader, SM2902, owns most of the long side, entered at $2.14 and up $1.88 million on paper.

item.title: Solana fell 4% to $71.79, and 27 top Hyperliquid traders are 99% short with $89 million
item.description: DeepSea counts $89.41 million of SOL shorts against $1.33 million of longs. Two of the bigger shorts were opened at about today's price.

item.title: Six hours after a $95 million long, Smart trader #72 now holds a $93 million bitcoin short
item.description: DeepSea's top bitcoin traders on Hyperliquid went from 82% short to 91% short overnight. The biggest new bet, a $92.76 million short at 40x, sits under the same label that held the biggest long at 12:39 a.m.

item.title: MetaDAO's META jumped 40% in under three hours as bitcoin fell. Upbit carried 83% of trading
item.description: The decision-market token went from about $3.32 to $4.66 on Thursday night ET while most coins slid. Daily volume, under $1 million a week ago, hit $21 million, mostly in Korean won.

item.title: Backpack's BP slid 22% in 30 hours and now trades below where Monday's 48% jump began
item.description: The exchange token fell from about $1.03 on Wednesday evening to about $0.80 early Friday. Monday's spike has been fully erased, and trading volume is a fifth of its peak.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin is 51% below its record but has not broken $60,000
item.description: Bitcoin slid to about $61,500 overnight, and posts about the drop spread fast. We checked six of the most repeated claims against price and fund data: four are true, one is partly true and one is wrong.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $90.8 million Thursday, and Wednesday's outflow was revised to $306 million
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a third straight outflow day as bitcoin slid to about $62,000 by the close. Wednesday's first reading was revised from $157.5 million out to $306.2 million out.

item.title: LayerZero (ZRO) fell 10% after a 23.6 million token unlock, on lower trading volume
item.description: DefiLlama's schedule put a 23.63 million ZRO release, 5.9% of the circulating supply, at 11:02 a.m. ET Thursday. ZRO was down 9.9% by early Friday, November 20, on lighter volume than most of last week.

item.title: Jupiter (JUP) fell 14% in a day, and DefiLlama shows no token unlock behind it
item.description: JUP dropped to $0.229 early Friday, November 20, the second-worst day in the top 100 after Pearl. DefiLlama lists no upcoming JUP unlocks, and trading volume stayed at its usual level.

item.title: Impossible Cloud Network (ICNT) is up 91% in three days and has doubled in a month
item.description: ICNT reached $0.437 early Friday, November 20, up 31% in 24 hours. Daily volume went from $2.45 million to $38.8 million in four days, led by Bitget, Bybit and Korea's Bithumb.

item.title: HYPE fell 4% to $64.99, and top traders' shorts shrank $40 million since Tuesday
item.description: DeepSea's top HYPE traders are still 92% short, but with $246.63 million instead of $286.51 million on Tuesday. Their average entry, $65.41, now sits right at the price.

item.title: An unnamed KOL wallet holds a $49 million bitcoin short at 40x as KOL 66ca tops the week
item.description: DeepSea's KOL board puts KOL 66ca first over seven days at +$2.76 million. On the bitcoin futures list, an unnamed influencer wallet shorted near $62,678, just above Friday's price.

item.title: Ether fell to $1,726, and 55 top Hyperliquid traders are 91% short with $366 million
item.description: DeepSea counts $365.62 million of ether shorts against $34.53 million of longs. The shorts' average entry is $2,143.90, so as a group they are well in profit. The biggest long is $6.89 million down.

item.title: Bitcoin hit $61,273, and a top trader's $95 million long faces liquidation at $60,183
item.description: A single 40x bet on a rise took the long share of DeepSea's top Hyperliquid traders from 7% on Thursday to 18%. Without it, the long side is about the same size as a day ago.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Anthropic prices at $83, but BNB Chain tokens show zero supply pre-open
item.description: Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83, above its range, and starts trading on Nasdaq today as ANT. A viral post says tokenized ANT goes live on BNB Chain on day one. We checked five claims: two hold up, two are unverified and one is misleading.

item.title: Sentient (SENT) up 19% as volume jumps 15-fold to $66 million, led by Upbit won trading
item.description: SENT climbed to about $0.0233 early Thursday, November 19, up 43% since November 10. Daily trading went from about $4 million to $66 million, and Korean won pairs on Upbit carried a quarter of it.

item.title: Bitwise files a Zcash ETF with ticker ZEC for the Texas Stock Exchange, fee still blank
item.description: Bitwise's S-1, filed November 17, names Coinbase as custodian and says the fund will not stake. The fee is still blank. Separately, Wednesday's bitcoin ETF outflow was revised to $306.2 million, almost double the first reading.

item.title: MARA lines up $185 million of 8.75% debt for its $1.5 billion power deal
item.description: Two SEC filings this week show MARA priced $185 million of 8.75% notes to help buy Long Ridge Energy & Power. Neither filing mentions bitcoin, weeks after the miner sold 13,597 coins to repay loans.

item.title: Terra Luna Classic (LUNC) jumps 17% in a day as Binance carries 41% of trading
item.description: LUNC rose about 17% in 24 hours to $0.00004528 early Thursday and climbed CoinGecko's trending list. Binance handled about $14.3 million of the roughly $35 million traded, including $5.6 million in Turkish lira.

item.title: K3's sBOLD vault hit with 10,000 borrowed wstETH and 9 million new BOLD in one transaction
item.description: An attacker hit K3 Capital's sBOLD savings vault on Ethereum on Wednesday morning. In one public transaction it borrowed 10,000 wstETH from Morpho, minted 9 million BOLD, cycled it through the vault and then paid ether to the wallet that built the attack contract.

item.title: Bitcoin fell to $62,068, and 97 top Hyperliquid traders are 93% short with $694 million
item.description: DeepSea counts $693.71 million of bitcoin shorts against $55.60 million of longs among 97 top Hyperliquid traders. With an average short entry of $72,018, the group is well in profit as bitcoin trades near $63,400.

item.title: Irys jumped 58% in a day as trading volume rose more than 40 times, led by Korean won pairs
item.description: IRYS climbed to about $0.025 while bitcoin fell. Daily volume went from about $3.4 million to $161 million, and Upbit's won market carried the most trading, CoinGecko data show.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $157.5 million Wednesday, pushing November's outflow to $2.55 billion
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a second straight outflow day as bitcoin closed near $62,500. Ether funds lost $17 million, their third outflow day in a row.

item.title: USDT on Plasma jumped 58% in 17 days to $1.09 billion while total USDT shrank
item.description: DefiLlama data show USDT on the Plasma chain rose $401 million since November 2, even as total USDT fell $598 million in a week. It is still about 80% below its October 18, 2025, peak of $5.35 billion.

item.title: USDC on Circle's Arc chain grew $245 million in a week as total USDC shrank $1.1 billion
item.description: DefiLlama data put USDC on Arc at $1.60 billion, up 18% in a week and 3.5 times its September low. It is level with Polygon, a hair behind in seventh place among USDC chains.

item.title: DeepSea's top two traders made $78.7 million in a week but hold just $14.5 million
item.description: SMc060 is back at No. 1 on DeepSea's smart money board, with SM6e36 right behind. SM6e36's assets roughly halved in a day while its profit rose, and Arbiscan shows neither wallet keeps any Aave USDC on Arbitrum.

item.title: One shark pulled $10.2 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a single trade
item.description: An unlabeled wallet made the day's biggest shark sale on any chain, more than 10 times the next one. Arbiscan shows it now holds none of the Aave token, and the pool's supply fell 7% in a day.

item.title: Pieverse jumps 66% in a day to a record $3.64 as Upbit retakes the lead in trading
item.description: PIEVERSE kept climbing after Wednesday morning's high and set another record in the evening while bitcoin and ether fell. Volume nearly quadrupled, and South Korea's Upbit carried 44% of it.

item.title: Gonka's Ethereum bridge lost $884,000 in USDT in one minute, then 22 million WGNK were minted
item.description: A wallet funded six hours earlier set a new key on Gonka's Ethereum bridge, pulled out 884,150 USDT and minted 22 million wrapped GNK on November 18, 2026. The WGNK price fell about 84% by evening.

item.title: Extended's XTEN airdrop: 300 million tokens, about 4.29 per point, sign by December 31
item.description: Perpetuals exchange Extended has set aside 30% of its XTEN token for points holders and opened a signing step in its app. U.S., UK and Canadian users are excluded, and half the supply goes to founders, team and investors.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Solana 1.0 is real; Zelle's $1.25 million stage transfer is unconfirmed
item.description: Solana's London conference set off a wave of posts: Solana 1.0, 150-millisecond finality, Zelle picking Solana, a $1.25 million on-stage transfer and NYSE's owner getting ready for Solana tokens. We checked six claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three hold up, one is misleading and two cannot be confirmed.

item.title: Pieverse hits record $2.52, up 132% in 30 days, as PancakeSwap pool takes 37.4% of trading
item.description: PIEVERSE beat its November 9 high on Wednesday morning while bitcoin slipped. This time a PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain, not South Korea's Upbit, handled the largest share of the volume.

item.title: Momentum (MMT) doubles to $0.25 in a day as trading volume hits 100 times last week's
item.description: The token of a Sui-based exchange ran from about $0.12 to $0.25 in 24 hours, with $310 million traded against a $51 million market value. It is still 94% below its 2025 record.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs' Tuesday outflow revised to $241.9 million; ether funds lost $26.3 million
item.description: Revised CoinMarketCap data show U.S. spot bitcoin funds lost $241.9 million on Tuesday, November 17, not $32.4 million. Ether funds lost $26.3 million instead of taking in $1.3 million.

item.title: Fake 'USDC' copied an $8.46 million Aave withdrawal to the cent, minutes after it happened
item.description: Two big wallets left Aave on Arbitrum on Tuesday. Within minutes, lookalike tokens started writing the same amounts into their histories, and Arbiscan tags the sender as phishing.

item.title: Smart money trader SMad53 traded $47.6 billion in 30 days. Its open bets total $3.06 million
item.description: The No. 6 wallet on DeepSea's 7-day board made $28.57 million in a month after a flat 90 days. It holds 30 small bets, all at 3x, and one bitcoin short makes up 90% of the total.

item.title: Two sharks pulled $18.5 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a day. Both now hold none
item.description: The No. 2 trader on DeepSea's smart money board took out its last $10.05 million. An unlabeled wallet withdrew $8.46 million. Arbiscan shows both balances at zero.

item.title: KOL 'tech' bought five PIKA tokens within a second of launch. Each pool now holds under $1
item.description: DeepSea logs the BNB Chain wallet buying every new PIKA within one second of launch. DexScreener now shows all five pools with less than $1 of liquidity.

item.title: SparkLend shrank $447 million in seven days while Maple grew 5.7% in a single day
item.description: DefiLlama data show the lender SparkLend fell 10% since November 10 to $4.00 billion, with a $404 million drop in one day. Lender Maple rose to $2.33 billion.

item.title: Rumor vs record: no official date for Predict.fun's airdrop claim, and no MetaMask token
item.description: Posts say PREDICT's delayed Season 1 claim opens November 18 and that a MetaMask token claim closes November 26. We checked four claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three could not be confirmed on any official page we could open, and one is wrong.

item.title: $515 million left Hyperliquid's bridge in 8 days. Arbitrum's USDC rose $92 million in a day
item.description: DefiLlama data show the Hyperliquid Bridge fell 8.4% since November 9 and USDC on Hyperliquid's chain dropped $194 million in a day. USDC on Arbitrum, Base Bridge and LayerZero gained.
